items.title: Make site provenance facts scan as one unit
items.problem: The default definition-list indentation and long rollback digest make a small proof panel look like raw generated output.
items.desiredOutcome: The four existing facts align in a compact responsive grid, retain the complete digest, and remain readable on narrow screens.
items.hypothesis: If we deliver "The four existing facts align in a compact responsive grid, retain the complete digest, and remain readable on narrow screens.", positive metrics rise on Community Web first viewport, Community Web responsive craft, Epoch site history.
antiGoals: do not hide or truncate the rollback digest
do not add animation, controls, or badges
items.smallestExperiment: Add a responsive CSS grid to the existing Epoch site-history definition list.
